comment: Own cluster as both the trainer and the sampler pool: async GRPO of Qwen3-4B (full parameters) on a 2-node trainer island of own 8 x B300 nodes (SSH + Docker, inventory.own-b300-nodes.yaml, roles: [trainer]) fed by an own SSH sampler pool of one 8 x B300 node (the inventory's roles: [sampler] node; Qwen3-4B vLLM, TP8) that starts its sampler through the unified node runtime; the pool copies prompts_file to the sampler spec's prompts.path (on the node behind the inventory mount) at every start and checks its size and sha256 there. <trainer-image> is the trainer image (as in examples/k31: name it; without --rl-image the launch resolves it from the site image catalog, else the built-in default). <sampler-image> must be a vLLM build that runs on B300 (sm103), e.g. the catalog's vllm-cuda-k31 image. Every node is your own: the run spends nothing (trainer.usd_per_h 0, the ssh pool bills nothing). budget.usd is a guard cap only: run up's preflight refuses budget.usd 0 while it prices any part of the run. budget.wall_h is the run.wall_clock breaker (3 h when unset), which every run up restarts. docs/OWN_CLUSTERS.md. yeto run up --config THIS.json --dry-run (add --check-nodes to check over SSH that the three nodes reach the store and the registry), then without --dry-run (it runs that check before it orders anything).
